name: VAST.ai public offers API (console.vast.ai/api/v0/bundles)
notes: Unauthenticated marketplace inventory endpoint used as a live price index. Filtered on {"gpu_name":{"eq":"<model>"},"num_gpus":{"lte":N}} then re-filtered in Python for num_gpus==N AND verification=="verified". Every offer's dph_total (USD per GPU-hour, total for the bundle incl. disk) divided by N gives a per-card hourly figure. These are ASK prices for rental capacity, not completed transactions. Re-fetch to refresh; the endpoint is live and changes constantly.
